title: qevc: Quantum Event Validity Certification — conditional validity of (quantum) event classifiers under collider systematics and estimation uncertainty
description:
Exact 0.3.0 / npjqi-submission-v1 release of the qevc research code and submission artifacts for Conditional validity of quantum event classifiers under collider systematics and quantum estimation uncertainty.

The archive contains the 26-page manuscript, 11-page Supplementary Information, one-page cover letter, self-contained submission/source ZIP, checksums and release README. The scientific program was closed before this release: the patch updates literature positioning, wording, methodological self-containment, typography and public-release synchronization without changing datasets, primary results, QPU raw data, models or frozen experimental configurations. The eight-qubit study is classically simulable, the IBM evidence is micro-scale, and no quantum advantage is claimed.
